As I understand it, the company is alleging breach of a three-year implementation agreement and wants us to begin formal dispute proceedings. The agreement has an arbitration provision, but the demand package hasn't been finalized yet. I'm also aware the supplier has threatened to terminate access to the implementation environment if this isn't addressed this month — so we have some time pressure. Before I can approve the demand, I need contract counsel, the client liaison, legal operations, and conflicts counsel to weigh in and report any issues that could affect the demand. Can each of you give me a status update from your area so we can get this moving?
